name: Unrestricted LP333 pq2-compression Kissat SAT discovery
hypothesis: The exact prescribed pq2-compression slice, strengthened by six unary margin counters and quotiented by its full 216-action decimation/swap group, may yield a directly verifiable unrestricted Legendre pair under a two-hour pinned Kissat satisfiable-target search.
evidence_unit: one proofless SAT-discovery run on the audited unrestricted ID0 identity-family pq2 slice, with Kissat 4.0.4 --sat, seed zero, and a 7200-second cap
claim_boundary: The pq2-uncompression statement is conjectural. Only a complete assignment that satisfies all 4494772 serialized clauses and independently verifies two binary length-333 rows, the prescribed compression, and combined PAF minus two at all 332 nonzero shifts is a candidate. Proofless UNSAT is nondecisive.

baseline.evidence: Formula SHA-256 7a893f92b28a7eed54ccefe5bbb89d28d04132672905abc3635d01a6e3991735 and independent formula audit status pass.
baseline.measurement: No directly verified SAT model exists in the campaign for the unrestricted prescribed [1,11,-11], [1,-11,11] compression slice.

intervention.one_change: Search the newly audited unrestricted pq2 formula with official pinned Kissat 4.0.4 in its documented --sat target mode, default seed zero, no proof output, and no configuration portfolio.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a partial or unaudited model

controls.name: formula-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind every structural addition to the unrestricted base equations.
controls.expected: The independent auditor reconstructs all 215 lex leaders and 848886 symmetry clauses, all six counters and 111444 serialized channel clauses, exact formula hash, functional truth tables, and a rejected one-literal mutation.

controls.name: compression-symmetry-group
controls.purpose: Ensure the quotient preserves the ordered pq2 seed.
controls.expected: All 216 units act once: units congruent to one modulo 3 decimate without swap and units congruent to two decimate with sequence swap; all six negative-count margins remain fixed.

controls.name: official-tool-pin
controls.expected: Kissat version 4.0.4, binary SHA-256 ca26c445800f6a88caebe925ee5b60d0907da4f1c8418f4044a51b1a22224983, source commit 8af8e56f174b778aef3aa45af9f739b2a5f492c2, with all 869 upstream tests passed.

controls.name: sat-positive-control
controls.purpose: Check status and complete-model extraction before target search.
controls.expected: The pinned solver returns SAT on known SAT ID3 cell 73 and its emitted complete assignment satisfies every one of 92904 serialized clauses.

controls.name: direct-target-model-audit
controls.purpose: Separate a solver status from a mathematical result.
controls.expected: Any target SAT assignment satisfies every CNF clause, reconstructs two length-333 sign rows with row sums plus one and the prescribed compression, and has combined PAF minus two at all 332 nonzero shifts; a controlled coordinate mutation is rejected.

controls.name: proofless-unsat-boundary
controls.expected: Any UNSAT solver status is archived only as proofless evidence and closes no family or unrestricted slice.

primary_metric.name: directly verified unrestricted pq2-slice SAT models

terminal_outcomes.promote: Kissat returns SAT and the complete assignment passes the exact CNF and independent direct full-length mathematical audit.
terminal_outcomes.park: The run reaches its cap or returns proofless UNSAT without a SAT model, while all controls remain valid.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A wall, memory, tool, extraction, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen arm without a valid terminal interpretation.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any tool pin, positive control, formula reconstruction, symmetry, counter, complete-model, CNF, direct PAF, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Require the passing independent formula audit before launching Kissat.
Run only Kissat 4.0.4 --sat with seed zero and the pinned binary.
Stop immediately on a directly verified SAT model.
Otherwise terminate at 7200 solver seconds or 4 GiB observed RSS.
Do not rerun with another seed, mode, formula, or larger cap.
Do not promote a proofless UNSAT status.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the audited LP333 pair, construct H668, independently verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the non-SAT manifest and move to a distinct structural repair mechanism rather than another Kissat configuration.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interrupted manifest and resume only the remaining frozen budget if the external interruption is reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest formula, tool, extraction, or direct-verification control before any new target run.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned repositories, the official open-source Kissat checkout, and public primary literature are authorized for the eight-hour autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared for submission; an actual external form action remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
